_meta.what_this_is: A five-token sequence with a fixed 4-dimensional embedding per token, standing in for the vectors a real model would compute. Small integers so every dot product is checkable by hand. The point is not the specific numbers but the structure: self-attention lets each position mix in every other position, and unless a causal mask forbids it, an early position mixes in tokens that come after it -- the future it must not see if it is going to predict the next token.
_meta.emb_is: A FIXTURE. Hand-picked distinct vectors so attention is non-uniform and the future leak is visible. Real embeddings are learned and high-dimensional; the mask lesson is identical.
